༄༅/ /dge bsnyen dang dge tshul du sgrub pa'i cho ga nyer mkho kun gsal bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu ru bud+dha dha dza ye/bla ma dang thams cad mkhyen pa la phya

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dge bsnyen dang dge tshul du sgrub pa'i cho ga nyer mkho kun gsal bzhugs// ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru bud+dha dha dza ye/ bla ma dang thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir tshigs snga ma dge tshul du bsgrub pa'i cho ga la/ sbyor ba dang / dngos gzhi dang / mjug gsum gyi/ dang po la rab tu byung bar rung mi rung brtag pa'i phyir bar chad dri ba dang / bstan pa la rim gyis slob tu gzhug pa'i phyir dge bsnyen du ba bsgrub pa dang / dge tshul gyi brtul zhugs blang ba'i phyir rab byung du bsgrub pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ bsgrub bya mdun du tsog tsog pur 'dug tu bcug la/ khyed rab tu byung bar byed pa la/ rgyud bar chad kyi chos dang mi ldan pa zhig dgos/ bar chad can rab tu byung na rgyud la sdom pa mi skye ba'am/ skyes kyang mi gnas pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas/ rgyud de la phan mi thogs shing / nged la'ang nyes pa 'ong bas bar chad dri dgos te/ mdo rtsa bar/ dang po'i mkhan po nyid kyis bar chad dris nas yongs su dag pa la skabs dbye'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ nged kyi dri ba 'di rnams la ma yengs par lan thob cig khyed mu stegs can ma yin nam/ bsgrub byas ma yin lags zhes brjod/ lo bco lnga ma lon pa ma yin nam/ bco lnga lon pa bya rog bskrod mi nus pa ma yin nam/ bya rog bskrod nus pa lo bdun ma lon pa ma yin nam/ bran la sogs pa ma yin nam/ bu lon chags pa min nam/ pha mas ma gnang ba ma yin nam/ pha mas ma gnang ba yul thag mi ring ba ma yin nam/ nad pa ma yin nam/ dge slong ma sun byung ba ma yin nam/ brku thabs su gnas pa ma yin nam/ da dad du gnas pa ya ma yin nam/ gnas par mi bya ba ma yin nam/ za ma ma yin nam/ ma ning ma yin nam/ sprul pa ma yin nam/ dud 'gro ma yin nam/ mu stegs can zhugs pa ma yin nam/ ma bsad pa ma yin nam/ pha bsad pa ma yin nam/ dgra bcom pa bsad pa ma yin nam/ dge 'dun gyi dbyen byas pa ma yin nam/

de bzhin gshegs pa la ngan sems kyis khrag phyung ba ma yin nam/ pham par 'gyur ba'i ltung ba bzhi po dag las ltung ba gang yang rung ba byung ba ma yin nam/ rgyud las bzlog pa'i chad pa khas mi len pa gnas nas phyung ba ma yin nam/ lag sdum la sogs pa ma yin nam/ skra ser la sogs ma yin nam/ sen mo gcig pa la sogs pa ma yin nam/ rgyal pos bkrab pa ma yin nam/ rgyal pos ma gnang ba ma yin nam/ rgyal pos ma gnang ba yul thag mi ring ba ma yin nam/ chom rkun par grags pa ma yin nam/ phung khrol ba ma yin nam/ lham mkhan pa ma yin nam/ gdol pa ma yin nam/ g.yung po ma yin nam/ mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba pa ma yin nam/ byang gi sgra mi snyan pa ma yin nam/ mtshan lan gsum du gyur pa ma yin nam/ skyes pa 'dra ba'i bud med ma yin nam/ sdig sdig lta bu'i mtshan nyid can ma yin nam/ gling gzhan nas skyes pa tshul byad mi 'dra ba ma yin nam/ ma yin no zhes zer na/ 'o na kho bos khyod rab tu byung bar bgyi'o/ /gnyis pa bstan pa la rim gyis slob pa'i phyir dge bsnyen du sgrub pa ni/ bsgrub bya de dang por ston pa la gnas lnga sa la gtugs pa'i phyag gsum 'tshal du bcug de nas rang la phyag gsum 'tshal du bcug nas/ bsgrub bya mdun du tsog tsog pur 'dug tu bcug cing / thal mo snying khar sbyor du bcug nas/ khyed rab tu 'byung bar byed pa la bstan pa la rim gyis bslab dgos te/ mdo rtsa bar/ dge bsnyen nyid dang / dge tshul nyid dang / dge slong nyid dag gis snga ma bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa la phyi ma mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dang por dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa blang dgos/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa la rigs mang du yod kyang / da res yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen du sgrub par byed pa la bsam pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khams gsum 'khor ba 'di gang du gnas kyang sdug bsngal gyi gnas/ su dang 'grogs kyang sdug bsngal gyi grogs/

ci la longs spyad kyang sdug bsngal gyi longs spyod las mi 'dug pas sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin can gyi 'khor ba las skyob pa'i skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum yin zhing / de yang sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi bas thar pa'i lam ston pa po zhu/ chos la skyabs su mchi bas mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam dngos zhu/ dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi bas lam sgrub pa'i zla grogs zhus nas/ mi gnas pa'i myang 'das rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ /de'i ched du dus 'di nas ma shi bar du yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa blang la bsrung / bdag bslab pa'i gzhi lnga 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun du gzung du gsol snyam pa gyis la 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ zhes sogs nas/ yid kyis bsdams nas legs par srungs shig ces pa'i bar kho bos byas pa'i dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa 'bog pa'i cho ga'i nang bzhin la/ bshad pa bsdu ba de tsam mdzad kyang rung / gsum pa dge tshul gyi brtul zhugs blang ba'i phyir rab byung du sgrub par byed pa la/ mkhan po zhig dgos/ de yang chos bdun ldan gyi dge slong zhig la mkhan por gsol ba ma btab na mkhan por mi 'gyur bas/ gsol ba btab pas/ khas blangs pa dang ldan pa cig dgos pas gsol ba 'debs/ mkhan po'i don yang dgag sgrub gnang gsum gyi bslab pa ston par byed cing / dman pa'i gnas su lhung ba las nye bar 'dzin pas na mkhan po zhes bya/ yang na dngos su bslab pa rin po che la sbyor zhing rgyud nas mya ngan las 'das pa la sbyor bar byed pas na mkhan po ste/ mdor na zag bcas kyi 'khor ba thams cad las nges par 'byung ba'i rab byung du sgrub mkhan mdzad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming bsgrub bya rang gi ming nas brjod 'di zhes bgyi ba/ slob dpon la mkhan por gsol gyis/ slob dpon bdag gi mkhan po mdzad du gsol/

slob dpon mkhan pos bdag rab tu byung bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum bzlas dgos pas/ gnyis pa'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ zhes pa nas/ rab tu byung bar bgyi'o bar brjod/ rjes zlos gsum pa'i skabs su mkhan por 'gyur ba yin/ de yang brjod pa gsum pa la cha gsum yod pa'i mkhan por gsol gyis yan chad cha dang po/ mkhan po mdzad du gsol yan chad cha gnyis pa/ tshig de'i mjug tu nged khyed kyi mkhan por gyur cing / de nas slob dpon mkhan pos zhes mi brjod par/ mkhan po mkhan pos zhes brjod dgos pas/ de thugs la zhog la gsum pa'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ zhes pa nas/ mkhan po mkhan pos bdag rab tu dbyung bar bgyi'o zhes pa'i bar brjod/ de ni mkhan por gsol ba gdab pa'i thabs yin no/ /bsgrub byas legs so zhes brjod do/ /mkhan por gsol ba btab pa'i bslab byar mkhan po la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed nas gus par bya ba/ yon dbul ba/ bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / bya ba thams cad mkhan po la zhus nas de'i bka' bzhin du bsgrub par bya ste/ de las 'das na mkhan por gsol ba btab pa nyams pa'i nyes par gyur ro/ /de nas mkhan po'i bya ba yin pas dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi bas bsgrub bya 'di zhes bya ba'i gtsug phud bregs pa'i grogs dan gyis zhes gsungs nas/ dge slong des kyang bsgrub bya'i mdun du 'ong ste/ bsgrub bya la ming ngam mtshan 'di zhes bgyi ba gtsug phud 'breg par spro'am/ zhes 'dri/ bsgrub byas spro zhes brjod/ de nas dge slong de bsgrub bya'i rgyab nas bregs pa'i gtsug phud mkhan po'i phyag tu phul/ mkhan pos/ gtsug phud ston pa'i mdun du bzhag cing / bstan pa la dga' ba'i lha rnams dges pa khyad par can bskyed du gsol/ zhes gsung bar bya'o/ /de nas mkhan pos bsgrub bya la/ dge slong 'dis rjes su 'brangs te yan lag lnga'i khrus shig mdzod/

khrus zin pa dang / bsgrub bya mkhan po'i mdun du sleb pa dang / mkhan pos rkang pa gnyis la gtugs te blang bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bsgrub bya'i mgo bo mkhan po'i zhabs gnyis la reg pa'i gnas lnga sa la gtugs pa'i phyag gsum 'tshal du bcug de nas bsgrub bya mdun du tsog tsog pur 'dug pa la bla gos phrag pa g.yon par bkal ba mkhan po dang / bsgrub bya gnyis kas chos gos kyi sne mo phyag g.yon pa'i steng du bzhag pa la/ phyag g.yas pas steng nas bkab pas bzung la/ mkhan pos 'di stod du rgyun du gon par byed pa'i chos gos bla gos zhes bya ba/ khyim pa dang / mu stegs can las gos kyi rtags khyad par du gyur pa/ dge sbyong gi dran pa gso/ sbrang bu dang / sha sbrang dang / nyi ma dang / rlung la sogs pa'i tsha grang gi gnod pa las skyob pa'i gos su gnang ba yin pas/ chos gos 'di lta bu rgyun du 'chang dgos pa yin/ zhes gsungs nas/ chos gos bsgrub bya'i phrag pa g.yas par spos/ thang gos gtad nas dpon slob gnyis kas sngar bzhin gzung la/ 'di smad kyi gang du gyon par byed pa'i thang gos zhes bya ba smad gcer ba dang / ngo tsha ba'i gnas las skyob/ sbrang bu la sogs pa'i gnod pa bsrung / khyim pa dang / mu stegs can las rtags khyad par du gyur/ dge sbyong gi dran pa gso ba'i gos su gnang ba yin pas dus rgyun du 'di 'dra ba re bcang dgos pa yin no/ /lhung bzed byin la/ dpon slob gnyis ka'i phyag g.yon pa'i mthil du lhung bzed bzhag phyag g.yas pas lhung bzed kyi kha nas bzung ste/ mkhan pos 'di lhung bzed ces bya ba/ khyim pa'i kha phor/ mu stegs kyi slong phor/ rab byung dman pa gzhan las snod spyod kyi rtags khyad par du gyur pa yin/ 'di zas kyis 'gengs pa bzhin du/ rang gi shes rgyud yod tan gyis 'gengs/ 'di yi nang nas zas la longs spyod pa bzhin du/ dam pa'i chos la longs spyod/

mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i bsod nams spyod pa'i snod du ston pas gnang ba yin pas/ snod spyad 'di lta bu 'chang dgos pa yin no/ /gding pa sbyin pa mkhan slob gnyis ka'i phyag gi bzung nas/ 'di gding ba zhes bya ba/ khyim pa'i dkar po/ gang zag gi khra bo phal cher ma nyams pa dang / dge 'dun gyi rtsa dang / lo ma'i gdan ma gtogs pa gnas mal la longs spyod pa'i dus su 'di'i skyabs nas longs spyod dgos pa yin no/ /de na chu tshags byin pa dpon slob gnyis ka'i phyag gis bzung nas/ 'di chu tshags zhes bya ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa snying rjes rab phye ba yin zhing / so sor thar pa'i sdom pa gzhan la gnod pa gzhi dang bcas pa las ldog pa yin pas/ sems can thams cad la gnod pa spang dgos/ khyad par du chu 'di 'brel che 'byung nye bas/ chu la srog chags yod med legs par brtags nas/ srog chags med pa'i chu ma rnyed na/ 'dis btsags nas longs spyod pa'i don du gnang ba yin pas/ chu tshags 'di 'dra re 'chang dgos pa yin/ des mtshon nas yo byad gang la'ang srog chags la mi gnod pa bya dgos so/ /zhes gsungs nas/ de nas mkhan pos bsgrub bya'i spyi bor 'bras la sogs pa'i me tog cung zad bzhag bsgrub bya'i yo byad de rnams bzung ste lang nas mdun du gnas pa la/ mkhan pos me tog gtor zhing / smon lam 'di ltar brjod par bya ste/ thar pa'i rgyan mtshan brtan par gyur cig tshangs par spyod pa tshe'i mthar phyin pa gyur cig tshul khrims kyi phung po yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig tshe rabs thams cad tu rab tu 'byung ba thob par gyur cig ces brjod/ de nas mkhan pos grogs byed pa la/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi bas bsgrub bya'i gos tshags legs par slob pa dang / bdag gi bya ba yang sgrubs shig ces bsgo/ de nas bar ma rab byung du sgrub pa ni/ bsgrub bya chos gos sogs legs par gyon pa des/ gding ba'i steng nas mkhan po la yan lag lnga sa la gtugs pa'i phyag gsum 'tshal du bcug la/

gding ba'i steng du tsog tsog pur 'dug cing thal mo snying khar sbyor du bcug la/ mkhan pos 'di skad ces/ khyed rab tu 'byung ba'i bsam pa skyes pa de shin tu legs/ legs pa'i rgyu mtshan dga' bo rab tu 'byung ba'i mdo las/ khyim pa rnams ni me 'ob na gnas pa lta bu/ rab tu byung ba rnams bsil khang na gnas pa lta bu/ zhes pa dang / cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa'i mdo las kyang / gang dag khyim na gnas pa byed bzhin du/ /byang chub dam pa mchog 'di thob pa yis/ /sangs rgyas gang yang sngon chad ma byung ste/ /ma 'ongs pa na'ang mi 'byung gnas pa med/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas na dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad rab tu byung ba'i rten la sangs rgyas pa yin la/ stong gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi bskal pa'i bar du bu dang chung ma sbyin par gtong ba dang / me tog la sogs pas sangs rgyas la mchod pa bas/ rab tu byung ba'i sems kyis dgon par gom pa bdun bor ba bsod nams che bar gsungs/ de yang rab byung dman pa mu stegs sogs kyi rab byung ma yin pa/ cho ga'i tshig zur las shākya'i rgyal po gtso bo de rab tu byung ba'i rjes su bdag kyang rab tu 'byung ste/ zhes 'byung bas shes pa lags/ rab byung du bsgrub pa la brje ba gsum dgos te/ rtags cha lugs brje ba ni/ khyim pa'i rtags chag lugs spangs/ rab tu byung ba'i rtags cha lugs su bsgrubs pas tshang pa yin/ bsam pa brje ba ni/ 'jig rten pa rnams kyi 'dod pa'i bsam pa la nyes pa dpag tu med pa yod pa yin/ spyir 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin can 'di spangs pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa thob pa'i phyir du rab tu 'byung snyam pa mdzod/ de tsam nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas la yang yod mod/ 'dir sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rab tu 'byung bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i sems dung pa bskyed mdzod/

de rnams spos pa'i brjed thor rus ming brje ba ni/ dpal dang bzang po la sogs pa'i mtha' can nam/ mkhan po'i mtshan gyi mtha' can du spos la/ 'di yi rjes zlos mdzad par zhu/ mkhan po dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di bsgrub bya'i chos ming gang yin pa nas brjod/ zhes bgyi bas/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid 'tsho'i bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ tshogs rnams kyi mchog dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa/ shākya seṅge/ shākya'i rgyal po/ gtso bo des rab tu byung ba'i rjes su bdag rab tu 'byung ste khyim pa'i rtags spong ngo / /rab tu byung ba'i rtags yang dag par len no/ /zhes lan gsum bzlas/ de ni bar ma rab byung du bsgrub pa'i thabs yin no/ /zhes brjod/ bsgrub byas legs so zhes bya'o/ /de ltar rab tu byung nas/ khyim pa'i rtags spong bar smras pas de nyams pa'i phyogs mthun gos dkar po dang / kha tshar can la sogs pa rnams spangs shing / skra dang kha spu ring por 'jog pa dang / dran pa'i phyogs ma yin pa'i spu bregs pa dang / tshong la sogs pa khyim pa'i spyod lam rnams spong ba dang / rab tu byung ba'i rtags len par khas blangs pa de nyams pa'i phyogs mthun mu stegs kyi rtags spyod lam brtul zhugs rnams spangs nas rab tu byung ba'i gtsang spra dang / brtul zhugs rnams la gnas par bya dgos pa yin no/ /des bar ma rab byung du bsgrubs zin nas/ dngos gzhi dge tshul du sgrub par byed pa la/ bsgrub bya de gding ba'i steng nas ston pa'i sku la phyag gsum dang / mkhan po rang la phyag gsum 'tshal du bcug gding ba'i steng du tsog tsog pur 'dug tu bcug cing / thal mo snying khar sbyor du bcug nas/

'o khyod dge tshul gyi sdom pa len pa la 'gal rkyen bar chad bzhi spangs pa/ mthun rkyen chos lnga tshang dgos pa la/ 'gal rkyen sdom pa skye ba dang / sdom pa gnas pa dang / khyad par du 'gyur ba dang / rten mdzes pa la bar du gcod pa ste bzhi med pa cig dgos te/ kho bos bar chad dris/ bsgrub bya rang gi lan drang por btab pas bar chad dang mi ldan par rtogs pas don grub pa yin no/ /mthun rkyen la/ yul dang / rgyud dang / bsam pa dang / cho ga mthun pa'i rkyen dang lnga las/ yul sangs rgyas ston pa'i sku gzugs dang / chos bslab pa la nan tan byed pa dang / las kyi cho ga yod pa dang / dam pa'i chos ma nub pa dgos pa de yang tshang / dge tshul gyi sdom pa gang zag las skye bas dge 'dun grangs tshang ba med na'ang rung / mkhan po yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pas dge slong la mkhan por gsol ba btab pas/ khas blangs pa cig dgos na/ de yang nged la bsgrub byas mkhan por gsol ba btab pas/ zhal gyi bzhes pa des grub pa yin/ slob dpon yang bsgrub bya'i rgyud la dge tshul gyi sdom pa 'bog pa'i cho ga'i brda sprod pa bdag gi 'grub rung du yod pas yul gyi rkyen gang dgos tshang / rgyud mthun pa'i rkyen dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung yan chad thob la ma nyams pa sogs dgos pa rnams kyang tshang / rtags mthun pa'i rkyen khyim pa'i rtags cha lugs rnams spangs shing / rab tu byung ba'i rtags cha lugs dang ldan par dgos pa rnams kyang legs par tshang ba yin/ bsam pa mthun pa'i rkyen la/ rgyu'i kun slong sdom pa thob 'dod dang / dus kyi kun slong sdom pa thob shes dang / 'gal rkyen nges pa lnga dang bral ba dang / de thams cad nges 'byung gi bsam pas zin pa rnams su yod pa las/ dang po ni skom pa chu 'dod pa ltar dge tshul gyi sdom pa zhe thag pa nas len 'dod dgos pa yang legs par tshang / dus kyi kun slong sdom pa thob shes kyang dngos gzhi'i skabs su 'byung rung du yod pas tshang ba yin/

gnyis pa 'gal rkyen nges pa lnga dang bral ba ni/ dus 'di nas bzung lte ji srid 'tsho'i bar du/ yul dus gnas skabs sems can thams cad la dge tshul gyi sdom pa bsrung ba'i bsam pa dang ldan pa cig nges par dgos pa yin/ de thams cad nges 'byung gi bsam pas zin pa ni/ chos kyis byed kyang nges 'byung gi bsam pa med na 'jigs skyob dang legs smon gang rung du 'gyur ba yin gyi/ thar pa'i lam du mi 'gyur/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba la/ nges 'byung gi bsam pas zin pa dgos te/ mdo rtsa ba las/ nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims kyi dbang du byas te/ zhes dang / 'dul ba sum brgya pa las/ nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims sdug bsngal spong / /zhes gsungs pas so/ /nges 'byung gi bsam pa yang / mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las/ sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams/ /yi dwags bkres shing skom pas nyams/ /dud 'gro gcig la gcig zas nyams/ /mi dag 'tsho ba thung bas nyams/ /zhes lha dag bag med pa yis nyams/ /'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam na/ /bde ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes dang / mgon po byams pas kyang / mi gtsang ba la dri zhim med bzhin 'gro lnga dag na bde ba'ang med/ /ces dang / rje btsun rin po ches kyang / mya ngan 'das pa bsgrub pa la/ /khams gsum la zhen pa spang yang 'tshal/ /khams gsum la zhen pa spong ba la/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dran yang 'tshal/ /zhes pa ltar yin/ de dag gi don ni/ sems can gyi khams la rtags na sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das te/ dmyal ba pa rnams la tsha grang gi sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa dang / yi dwags rnams la bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal/ dud 'gro rnams la gcig la gcig bza' ba dang / glen cing gti mug pa'i sdug bsngal/ lha ma yin la 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal/ lha rnams kyang shi 'phos nas ngan song du skye bar 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal/ mi rnams la'ang chen po rnams la sems kyi sdug bsngal/

dman pa rnams la lus kyi sdug bsngal/ 'dod pa thog tu mi 'bab cing / mi 'dod pa thog tu babs pa'i sdug bsngal/ mdor na skye ba dang na ba dang rga ba dang 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal las ma 'das pas sdug bsngal can gyi 'khor ba 'di spangs pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa thob par bya/ de'i ched du dge tshul gyi sdom pa len snyam pa'i sems dung pa bskyed mdzod/ /nges 'byung gi bsam pa de tsam theg pa dman pa rnams la'ang yod mod/ da res theg pa chen po'i sdom pa len par byed pa la/ sdom gsum rab dbye las/ bsam pa sems bskyed kyis zin pa'i/ /cho ga nyan thos lugs bzhin gyis/ /so so thar pa rigs brgyad po/ /byang sems so sor thar par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas na/ nam mkha' la mtha' med pas sems can la mtha' med/ mtha' med pa'i sems can thams cad kyis rang re'i pha ma ma byas pa gcig kyang med/ pha ma byas res kyis phan tshad med pa btags pa'i ma rgan 'di rnams snying re rje/ snying rje zhes bzhag pas mi phan/ 'di rnams sdug bsngal las bsgral te bde ba la 'god par byed pa da lta bdag la nus pa med cing / bdag las che ba tshangs pa dang / brgya byin/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams la'ang med/ su la yod na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid la yod pa yin/ des na bdag gi sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid 'tsho'i bar du dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song te/ dge tshul gyi sdom pa blangs la bsrung snyam pa'i sems dung pa bskyed mdzod/ cho ga mthun pa'i skyen la/ sbyor ba dang / dngos gzhi/ mjug gi cho ga gsum yod pa las/ sbyor ba'i cho ga song nas/ dngos gzhi'i cho ga 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di bsgrub bya rang gi chos ming nas brjod/ zhes bgyi ba/ dus 'di nas bzung ste/

ji srid 'tsho'i bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshogs rnams kyi mchog dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag ji srid 'tsho'i bar du dge tshul du btsun pas bzung du gsol/ /'di rang don du brjod pa'i sngags yin pas/ gnyis pa'i yang mdzod/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ zhes pa nas/ btsun pas bzung du gsol/ zhes pa'i bar rjes zlos dang / cho ga brjod pa gsum pa'i skabs su dge tshul gyi sdom pa thob pa yin/ de yang cho ga gsum pa 'di la skyabs brjod pa/ bdag brjod pa/ gzhan brjod pa dang gsum yod pa'i/ dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o zhes pa yan skyabs brjod pa/ dge tshul du zhes pa yan chad bdag brjod pa/ btsun pas bzung du gsol zhes pa gzhan brjod pa yin/ bdag brjod pa dge tshul du zhes pa'i tshig dge tshul du zhes pa la gsung dpang mtho ba mdzad/ rdzogs pa'i rjes su dge tshul gyi sdom pa thob pa yin snyam du bsgrub byas nges pa dang / bsgrub bya'i rgyud la dge tshul gyi sdom pa thob nas nged bsgrub bya'i dge tshul gyi slob dpon du gyur pa yin pas/ slob dpon du gyur nas btsun pas bzung du gsol zhes mi brjod par/ slob dpon gyis bzung du gsol zhes brjod dgos pa yin pas/ de thugs la bzhag la/ gsum pa'i yang rjes zlos mdzod/ btsun pa dgos su gsol/ zhes pa nas/ slob dpon gyis bzung du gsol zhes brjod par mdzad do/ /de nas slob dpon gyis thabs yin no zhes dang / bsgrub byas legs so zhes brjod/ des dngos gzhi'i cho ga grub/ mjug gi cho ga la gnyis yod pa'i/ dang po sdom pa thob rgyu'i go ba yang mdor bsdus brjod na/ bsnyen bkur gyi gnas ni dge slong pha thams cad dang / rang las bslab pa rgan pa'i dge tshul pha thams cad yin/ bsnyen bkur gyi gnas ma yin pa ni/

dge bsnyen dang rang las bslab pa gzhon pa'i dge tshul dang / khyim pa thams cad gnas ma yin/ bsnyen bkur rang gi ngo bo ni/ phyag 'tshal ba dang / gral gong du 'jog pa la sogs pa rnams yin/ de dag go ba'i ched du lo dang dus la sogs pa brjod par byed pa la/ khyed kyi dge tshul gyi sdom pa thob pa'i lo 'di chu pho rta'i lo yin/ de la dus tshod lnga yod pa'i dpyid dus kyi zla ba bzhi pa chu stod yin/ de yar ngo mar ngo gnyis yod pa'i yar ngo / de la tshes grangs bco lnga yod pa las/ yar ngo'i tshes bzhi chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus yin/ de la nyin mo dang mtshan mo'i cha gnyis yod pa las/ nyin mo'i cha yin/ de la cha du ma yod pa las/ dge tshul gyi sdom pa thob pa'i dus snga phyi la dpags te brjod par mdzad dgos/ de ltar bsnyen bkur gyi gnas rnams la bsnyen bkur 'bul ba dang / bsnyen bkur gyi gnas ma yin pa rnams kyi bsnyen bkur dang du blang bas rang gzhan gyi bslab pa la gus pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bcas pa dang mthun pa la sogs pa'i phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pas de rnams phyag len la theb par mdzod/ da mjug chog gnyis pa/ sdom pa thob pa mi nyams shing 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir bslab bya brjod pa ni/ dge tshul gyi sdom pa thob pa tsam gyis mi chog bsrung dgos/ ma bsrung na nyes pa chen po 'byung ste/ dge slong la rab tu gces pa'i mdo las/ la la'i tshul khrims bde ba ste/ /la la'i tshul khrims sdug bsngal yin/ /tshul khrims ldan pa bde ba ste/ /tshul khrims 'chal pa sdug bsngal yin/ /zhes gsungs pas legs par bsrung dgos/ srung lugs dgra bcom pa rnams kyi dge tshul gyi spang bya bcu po yid kyis spangs nas lus ngag gis slar log pa bzhin du/ bdag gis kyang dus 'di nas ma shi bar du spang bya bcu po 'khor dang bcas pa yid kyis spangs nas lus ngag gis slar log par bya'o snyam pa gyis la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog gcod pa spangs te/ srog gcod pa las slar log pa de bzhin du/ bdag chos ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang / dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog gcod pa spangs te srog gcod pa las slar log par bgyi'o/ /yan lag dang po 'di'i bdag 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gi bslab pa la rjes su slob bo/ /rjes su bsgrub bo/ /rjes su bgyid do/ /gzhan yang ji ltar 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis ji srid 'tsho'i bar du ma byin par len pa dang / mi tshangs par spyod pa dang / brdzun du smra ba dang / 'bru'i chang dang / bcos pa'i chang dang / myos par 'gyur ba bag med pa'i gnas dang / glu gar dang / rol mo'i sgra dang / phreng ba dang / spos nyug pa dang / rgyan dang / kha dog 'chang ba dang / khri gdan mthon po dang / khri gdan chen po dang / dus ma yin pa'i zas dang / gser dngul len pa spangs te/ gser dngul len pa las slar log pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang / dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid 'tsho'i bar du ma byin par len pa dang / mi tshangs par spyod pa dang / brdzun du smra ba dang / 'bru'i chang dang / bcos pa'i chang dang / myos par 'gyur ba/ bag med pa'i gnas dang / glu gar dang / rol mo'i sgra dang / phreng ba dang / spos nyug pa dang / rgyan dang / kha dog 'chang ba dang / khri gdan mthon po dang / khri gdan chen po dang / dus ma yin pa'i zas dang / gser dngul len pa spangs te/ gser dngul len pa las slar ldog par bgyi'o/ /yan lag bcu pa 'dis bdag 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gi bslab pa la rjes su slob bo/ /rjes su bsgrub bo/ /rjes su bgyid do/ /de nas slob dpon gyis thabs yin no/ /zhes dang / bsgrub byas legs so bya'o/ /de ltar dngos su blangs pa'i bslab pa bcu las rtsa ba bzhi las 'das na/

pham pa dang 'dra ba'i nyes byas/ yan lag drug las 'das nas/ bshags bya'i nyes byas/ phyogs mthun las 'das na gdams bya'i nyes byas/ nyes par med par snang ba rnams la nyes pa med par shes par byas nas legs par bsrung dgos pa yin no/ /de ltar dge tshul gyi sdom pa thob ma thag pa de la/ la las sogs pa thams cad kyi phyag bya ba'i gnas su gyur pa yin pas dga' spro rgya chen po mdzad pa zhu/ bka' drin gtang rag tu nged la phyag gsum mdzad par zhu/ bsgrub bya de gding ba'i steng du bzhengs nas thugs khar thal mo sbyar te sku drin che lags zhes brjod/ de nas mkhan po dang / grogs dag smon lam shes pa rnams kyi bsgrub bya la mi tog gtor/ thar pa'i rgyal mtshan brtan par gyur cig zhes sogs gong gi tshig bcad dang / dge ba 'di yi skye bo kun/ la sogs pa'i smon lam mdzad/ 'di dag ni tshig snga ma dge tshul du sgrub pa'i cho ga bstan zin nas/ tshig phyi ma bsnyen rdzogs su sgrub pa'i tshul logs su 'chad par bdag spro'o/ /zhes dge bsnyen dang dge tshul du bsgrub pa'i cho ga nyer mkho kun gsal zhes bya ba 'di yang / shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ gling kha bde ba can gyi yang dben bsam gtan phug gi rje sems dpa' chen po dang / sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa sogs nas bdag gi bla ma'i bar gyi skyes chen dam pa rnams kyi sgrub phug chos kyi pho brang ga la ba der mkhan po don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te/ thub dbang gnyis pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi drung du bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa legs par thob pa'i dus su/ 'di lta bu'i yig cha zhig bgyid 'dod byung ba bzhin/ de nas yun ring ma lon par chos grwa chen po dpal ldan sa skyar legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa yang rang nyid do/ /'di'i thub dbang zas gtsang sras kyi bstan pa dang /

nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can rnams la phan pa rgyun mi 'chad par gyur cig/ //sarba baṅgalaṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 6 a myes zhabs/ dge bsnyen dang dge tshul du sgrub pa'i cho ga nyer mkho kun gsal/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 5
